title: 第十五章源能点数的获取第十六章刮目相看
content_zh:
;;
次日清晨。
【名称】：江宁
【源能】：3.9
【技艺】：
识文断字（一次破限692000）（特效：过目不忘）
五禽拳（入门4100）
当他打开自己的面板后，瞬间一愣。
“源能竟然一日增加了0.3？”
“这是我两个多月以来，唯一一次源能增长出现0.3的情况！”
“如此来看，之前我的推断是正确的！源能的增长与我当日的摄入能量有关！”
“我昨日摄入了一颗野参的十分之一，同时又摄入了武馆的一碗汤药，以及肉食和大量的米饭，所以才能做到一日增加0.3的源能。”
他若有所思，心中对于源能的增长逻辑渐渐明悟。
“看来过些天我就得想办法搞钱了！没钱没野参这等补药支撑我练拳，源能也会因此增长缓慢！”
他此刻对于穷文副武这四个字的认知更深了。
财富对他习武而言，太重要了！
【五禽拳经验值+1】
......
【五禽拳经验值+1】
【此次练拳，五禽拳经验值共计增加2点。】

【技艺】：五禽拳（入门6100）
“五禽拳入门至精通已达百分之五的进度了！”
江宁又握了握拳头，气血之力流转，涌入他的右拳。
“气血贯通一臂被称之为气血小成，我如今还差的太多了！”
他脑海中顿时又产生了一个新的想法。
也不知道五禽拳破限，究竟能产生什么特效？
想到这里，他随即微微摇头：“我有些想多了！武道功法也是入门，精通，小成，大成，圆满五境。唯有圆满之后，方能破限，以目前肝五禽拳经验值的效率，也不知道还要多久！”
随后，江宁又来石锁面前。
右手抓在百斤重的石锁上，轻轻一提，便脱离了地面。
“比昨夜更加轻松，看来我的体魄又增长了些许！”
感受到力量的变化，江宁心中暗爽。
content_en:

Early next morning.
[Name]: Jiangning
[Source Energy]: 3.9
[Technique]:
Reading and hyphenation (breaking the limit of 692,000 at a time) (Special effect: photographic memory)
Five-animal boxing (entry level 4100)
When he opened his panel, he was stunned for a moment.
"The source energy actually increased by 0.3 in one day?"
"This is the only time in more than two months that my source energy has increased by 0.3!"
"Looking at it this way, my previous inference is correct! The growth of source energy is related to my energy intake that day!"
"Yesterday I consumed one-tenth of a wild ginseng, and at the same time a bowl of medicine from the martial arts school, as well as meat and a lot of rice, so I was able to increase my source energy by 0.3 per day."
He was thoughtful, and gradually understood the logic of the growth of source energy.
"It seems that I will have to find a way to make money in the next few days! Without money and supplements such as wild ginseng to support my boxing practice, the growth of source energy will be slow!"
At this moment, he had a deeper understanding of the four words "poor essay and deputy martial arts".
Wealth is too important for him to practice martial arts!
[Five-animal fist experience value +1]
...
[Five-animal fist experience value +1]
[In this practice, the experience value of Wuqinquan will be increased by 2 points in total. 】
[Skill]: Five-animal boxing (entry level 6100)
"We have reached 5% progress from introduction to Wuqinquan to mastery!"
Jiang Ning clenched his fist again, and the power of Qi and blood flowed into his right fist.
"Having Qi and blood in one arm is called a minor achievement in Qi and blood. I'm still far behind!"
A new idea suddenly came to his mind.
I don’t know what special effects Wuqinquan can produce by breaking the limit?
Thinking of this, he immediately shook his head slightly: "I'm a little overthinking! Martial arts skills are also beginners, mastery, small success, great success, and the five realms of perfection. Only after perfection can the limit be broken. With the current efficiency of liver five-animal fist experience, I don't know how long it will take!"
Later, Jiang Ning came to Shi Suo again.
He grabbed the stone lock weighing a hundred kilograms with his right hand and lifted it off the ground with a slight lift.
"I feel more relaxed than last night. It seems that my body has grown a little bit stronger!"
Feeling the change in power, Jiang Ning felt relieved.
